Floor, bath and shower feature custom travertine tile work with a matching diamond motif.

Custom tiled shower for two is custom designed with high-end plumbing fixtures, featuring a dual showerhead system. One side includes a tall fixed wall-mounted showerhead with multiple recessed body jets for a spa-like experience...
...The other side features a removable hose sprayer for more flexibility. Dual water heaters ensure that even long showers can stay hot and luxurious

photos/basement/guest-suite-bedroom-6/gu: The generous size of this guest suite allows for a king-size bed with room to spare, along with additional furnishings such as a seating area, bookcases, or a workspace. Separate doors allow privacy from the both the connected guest bathroom and the walk-in closet.

Plush wall-to-wall carpeting adds warmth and comfort underfoot, while a large window and plentiful recessed light fixtures provide excellent, even illumination throughout the room, making it feel bright and open despite being downstairs. The room is wired for entertainment, including wall-mounted media plugs, and cable and ethernet on multiple walls. Dimmable track lights make it easy to read in bed.
photos/basement/guest-bathroom-4/guest-b: This well-appointed guest suite bathroom features a thoughtfully designed layout with dual vanities and plenty of storage.
The wood cabinetry is topped with a granite countertop and integrated sink, offering both durability and timeless style.
Framed mirrors and warm vanity lighting provide a polished, inviting feel while ensuring excellent task lighting.
The bathroom includes a tiled walk-in shower with decorative accent banding, built-in corner shelving, and a pebble-style shower floor for added texture and comfort.
A dual-mode shower system can be used as an adjustable-height fixed showerhead or as a handheld sprayer.
Neutral tile flooring, oil-rubbed bronze-style fixtures, and soft earth-tone walls create a cohesive, spa-like atmosphere.
The separate toilet area enhances privacy, making this an ideal setup for overnight guests or extended stays.
photos/basement/guest-walk-in-closet/gue: A large walk-in closet comes off of the Guest Suite and includes built in shelving. The closet leads to additional storage area under the stairwell which also has built-in shelving for lots of storage.
photos/basement/guest-kitchen-dining-2/g: This room was designed to be a guest kitchen/dining area and is plumbed for a full kitchen. A small dining area and separate entry area lead to the walk-out stairwell. Solid external door has secure keypad access and deadbolt and is wired for a separate doorbell. It could be the entry to a separate rental unit or mother-in-law apartment with quick access to separate parking pad.
photos/basement/living-office-bedroom-7/: Photo coming soon. This large room was designed to flex to meet different needs. It has locking doors on both sides that allow it to be locked off to serve as a family room, large office, or additional bedroom as part of the primary residence. Or it can be locked off and serve as a living room or 2nd bedroom as part of the guest suite or an ADU.
photos/basement/exercise-room-bedroom-8/: Downstairs bedroom #3 is large and has 2 connected room areas that could alternatively work as an exercise room, or a family room/game room.

The generous wall space allows for flexible furniture placement, from a king bed to a sectional. Recessed lighting provides bright, even illumination, making the room feel inviting and functional at any time of day.
It has two big windows, a large bifold closet, and plenty of outlets, including 2 high wall multi-media outlets for big-screen tvs.
